name: World Rock Bebé 2026
description: A rock 'n' roll celebration designed for the whole family. Introduce your little ones to the world of music in this fun and energetic concert series.
longDescription:
World Rock Bebé 2026 is a family-oriented concert event held at the Auditório Municipal de Gaia. This series of performances aims to introduce young children to rock music in an engaging and accessible format. The event is structured to be suitable for all ages, providing an early exposure to musical genres beyond traditional children's entertainment.

Attendees can expect an energetic atmosphere designed for participation and enjoyment by both children and adults. The performances are crafted to be interactive, encouraging movement and engagement from the audience. The Auditório Municipal de Gaia provides a dedicated space for these musical events, offering a comfortable setting for families.

Tickets for World Rock Bebé 2026 are available for purchase. The Auditório Municipal de Gaia is located in Vila Nova de Gaia, easily accessible from Porto via public transport. Specific details regarding metro, bus, or tram connections can be found on local transport websites. The event is categorized as family-friendly.
